spec.title: Clone Graph
spec.summary: Given a node reference in a connected undirected graph, return a deep copy of every reachable node and edge.
spec.description: Given a node reference in a connected undirected graph, return a deep copy of every reachable node and edge. Each copied node must be a new object with the same value and corresponding copied neighbors. Return null for an empty graph. Node values are unique; the supplied reference is the node with value 1, and the test format represents edges with an adjacency list.
constraints: Every node is reachable from the supplied node when the graph is nonempty.

examples.explanation: Two distinct copied nodes remain connected in both directions.
A missing input node yields no cloned graph.

approaches.name: Clone While Traversing
approaches.summary: Map each original node to one new node, then recursively connect its copied neighbors.
thinkingSteps: Return null if the input reference is absent.
Create and remember a clone before visiting neighbors, so cycles can revisit it safely.
Connect each clone to the clones of its original neighbors.

bullets: The copy must use new node objects.
An undirected edge can lead back to an already visited node.
A map prevents duplicate clones of the same node.
